description: This file defines a TinyMCE plugin called 'Development Kit' (devkit). It includes plugin initialization, logging, debugging, and method wrapping for TinyMCE editor instances.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information including name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: _setup
methods.description: Sets up the plugin, creates iframe, loads CSS, and initializes logging parameters.

methods.name: _end
methods.description: Calculates and logs execution time for benchmarking.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Logs messages with filtering and timestamp.

methods.name: _debugEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables debug event logging for TinyMCE instances.

methods.name: _debugEvent
methods.description: Handles debug events, logs event type and target.
